 

Flow Cytometry Shared Services 

 

Sample:  

Sample buffer: PBS + 10% FBS, optional 1 mM EDTA.   

If you use trypsin to detach the cells, do it as short as possible.  3-5 min range.  Longer time results in aggregation.  Centrifuge gently, with just enough speed to bring cells down.  

Too many dead cells and DNA released from them can make the sample sticky. 

Sample volume 300-500 ul, cell number: 0.2-2 million.  Samples with high concentration will clog the cytometer. 

Keep samples on ice.   

 

Tubes:  

Falcon 12x75mm tube, no cap Cat# 352008 

                                             Snap cap (sterile) Cat# 352054 

Accuri cytometer can also use eppendorf tubes. 

If there are clumps, filter using Falcon 5 ml tube with strainer cap (352235).
